mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the local weather. It is a clear 72 degrees outside the Verona Public Library. If you are heading out, the space station will be visible tonight starting at 8:21 PM, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and heading toward the northeast near Home Depot, climbing about halfway up the sky. The overnight low will be 53 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is currently accepting applications for its Citizen Academy, a free nine-week program running from September 23 to November 18 that offers insights into O W I investigations and other police operations. Additionally, residents should be aware of several election notices regarding the upcoming November general election.

There is plenty to do this weekend. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the town will be buzzing with the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival, followed by yoga on September 14 and trivia nights starting September 15.

On September 10, officers were dispatched to a residence on Hunters Cove Way for a burglary in progress. A suspect was located and taken into custody, and while a firearm was discharged, there were no injuries.
Today's delicious flavor was Chocolate Caramel Twist. As we are now closed for the night, we invite you back tomorrow morning starting at 10:00 AM to try our next flavor, which is Snickers Swirl.
